story: The Hodgsons Redstart (Phoenicurus hodgsoni) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Muscicapidae family. It is most commonly observed in Hilly/montane open forests; forest edge; scrubby edge; valleys; meadows; and coniferous forest, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Hodgsons Redstart is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Hodgsons Redstart into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
